description: Unified HPC Bare-Metal & Fabric Observability — RDMA/RoCEv2, GPU/NVLink/PCIe, CPU/NUMA/Storage. Multi-cluster via cluster_id label. DCGM metrics require NVIDIA DCGM-Exporter.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster_id, node, severity, counter) (rate(hpc_pcie_aer_errors_total{cluster_id=~"$cluster",node=~"$node"}[1m]) or 0 * hpc_pcie_aer_errors_total{cluster_id=~"$cluster",node=~"$node"})

title: [HPC] Unified Bare-Metal & Fabric Infrastructure
